provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: IMP-09: a resource assigned to a field of the object under construction inside an inner if/try is owned by the construction, not the inner block; on failure it is released; a temporary dies with its block (constructor scope) first. Successful holders destroy the parent before owned children, children in reverse registration order.
